messages:
dana: heads-up: canary for release v2.14 rolling in ap-southeast-2, deploy-bot reports initial success

deploy-bot: [deploy] v2.14.0 canary started at 2026-03-20T02:45Z on pool:dedicated-ap-southeast-2

kai: seeing elevated tail latency on 99th for text-gen routes, ~420ms -> baseline 180ms

laura: any errors in logs? request_ids?

matt: customers on Dedicated may notice slow responses, we should pre-draft statuspage copy

kai: diag shows increased kernel stall when sequence len > 1024, probably new kernel selection path

dana: recommend emergency pin: rollback not ideal, instead pin affected dedicated pools to runtime v2.13.2 for next 2hr to stabilize

laura: agree. I'll draft two customer messages: one short for statuspage and one email for committed customers

matt: include timeline and mitigation + ETA for fix

dana: statuspage snippet draft:
"Investigating increased latency for text-generation in ap-southeast-2. Impact: a subset of Dedicated customers may experience higher than normal response times. Mitigation: affected pools will be pinned to a previous runtime to restore baseline performance. We will update within 2 hours."

kai: +1

laura: customer email subject: "Notice: temporary performance mitigation in AP-Southeast-2"

laura: email body short: "We observed elevated latencies for text-generation for customers in AP-Southeast-2. We've pinned the runtime for affected Dedicated pools to a stable version to restore performance. No customer data loss expected. Next update within 2 hours or when resolved."

matt: suggested statuspage tags: component:dedi-ap-southeast-2, severity:minor, notify:all_subscribers

dana: action items:
- @kai pin dedicated pools to v2.13.2 (done by 03:10Z)
- @deploy-bot post rollback/pin annotation to release thread
- @laura publish statuspage and send emails to committed customers

kai: pin applied. confirm baseline latency back to ~190ms

deploy-bot: [action] pinned pool:dedicated-ap-southeast-2 -> runtime:v2.13.2 by user:kai at 2026-03-20T03:09Z

laura: statuspage published: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/rdw-2026-03-20-1

matt: emailing committed customers now, using the draft

dana: logging this thread for postmortem & rollout notes, add to release notes: "hotfix: pin dedicated runtime in ap-southeast-2 due to latency regression during v2.14 canary"

kai: recommend backport fix to kernel selection in v2.14.1, follow-up ticket created: INFR-5872

laura: any reason to open a customer-facing RCA?
matt: if it persists or affects SLA. for now we'll do an incident note and follow up with RCA if requested

dana: thanks all, keep updates here if anything changes :thumbsup:
